page.layout: One printed page, title page: centred title lines in several sizes, a printer's ornament and a publisher's imprint below. Library stamps and a Google watermark at the edges are not printed text and are omitted.

main_text.l: Seriem omnium, quæ hoc tractatu continen- tur, pagina post dedicatione indicabit.

page.notes: The "Syntagma." line is set in italic with a long tail on the final letter; transcribed as printed. The imprint "Typis" has a decorated initial T. The printer's ornament in the middle of the page has no text. Ink stamps (Biblioteca Nazionale Roma, a circular stamp) and a Google watermark are excluded as non-printed matter. The date ANNO M. DC. XLVI. is set in small capitals with a mixed-case stroke; read as XLVI. Minor doubt: "Seriem omnium" line is in italic with a broken word at "continen-tur", transcribed with the hyphen as printed.
